name: @pipeworx/mcp-fruityvice

tools.name: get_fruit
tools.description: Get nutritional facts for a specific fruit. Returns calories, protein, fat, carbs, sugar, and fiber per 100g (e.g., 'apple', 'banana').

tools.name: list_fruits
tools.description: List all available fruits with their nutritional profiles. Returns name, calories, protein, fat, carbs, sugar, and fiber for each.

tools.name: get_by_nutrition
tools.description: Find fruits matching a nutritional range. Specify nutrient type (calories, sugar, fat, carbs, protein) and min/max values to filter results.

nutrient.description: The nutrient to filter by. One of: calories, sugar, fat, carbohydrates, protein.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-fruityvice forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the fruityvice pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
